evidence.note: ParoQuant is a post-training weight quantization method for reasoning LLMs that uses pairwise Givens rotations plus channel-wise scaling to even out per-channel outlier magnitudes, achieving 2.4% higher accuracy than AWQ on reasoning tasks at under 10% inference overhead.
evidence.title: ParoQuant: Pairwise Rotation Quantization for Efficient Reasoning LLM Inference
